message.reasoning: Okay, the user wants to make sure all doors are properly locked. I first checked the available tools and found mcp_tool_displayCarStatus with a doors option. Calling that returned all doors as unlocked. Now, I need to act on this. The user mentioned some doors are ajar, so the display confirms they're unlocked. The next step is to lock them. The appropriate tool is mcp_tool_lockDoors. Parameters require unlock as false and specify the doors. Since all are unlocked, I'll set unlock to false and include all door names. That should lock all doors. Need to make sure the JSON is correctly formatted with the array of doors and the unlock parameter. Once done, confirm the action and await feedback.
